packageRules.description: Runtime dependencies: one weekly PR. Its fix(deps) commit makes a release (of the client too when it touches packages/client)
Dev dependencies: one weekly PR, chore(deps), so no release
Runtime dependencies of one package that are dev dependencies of another (the UI package's react, the client's bullmq) stay in the runtime PR, so every package.json keeps the same version
GitHub Actions, and the Node version they set up: one weekly PR
Base images of the app, ingest and Postgres images: one weekly PR, fix(deps) since it changes what runs in production

TypeScript and the linters move together (oxlint-tsgolint is built against a TypeScript release), apart from the other dev dependencies: their new rules often need code changes, which would hold the whole group back
Bun moves at once in packageManager, the Dockerfiles' oven/bun images and @types/bun; fix(deps) since the images run on it
drizzle-kit and drizzle-zod must match the drizzle-orm version, across dependencies and devDependencies
Majors can break things: listed in the Dependency Dashboard, and opened (one PR per monorepo) only once ticked there, for a human review
